title: تأهيل المضيف
rule:
Applies when: Before claiming effective protected operation.
Verify real instruction loading and relevant enforcement routes on the selected host/OS; a local validator or refusal example is not host qualification.
rationale: عرض محلي ناجح قد يوهم بأن المضيف يحمي التنفيذ الفعلي. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
reviewCadence: Owner review before activation and after material changes
